certification_rule: Each phase may PASS only on measurement integrity and protocol compliance. PASS does not mean V2 is economically useful.

frozen_semantics.candidate: Shadow research candidate only; no native ExitDecision authority.
frozen_semantics.memory: A predefined causal structural-progress event; not proof of success or profitability.
frozen_semantics.v2: First strictly-later completed close below the frozen first-Memory breakout reference; descriptive only, no exit authority.

global_rules: Original and audited eligibility must never be silently conflated.
Missing or invalid causal bars are not no-signal opportunities.
NO_MEMORY is a result among Memory-evaluable lifecycles, not an exclusion reason.
Primary V2 study stops at native terminal event when that event is causally verified.
Prohibited outcome exit_time must not be used implicitly to establish native terminal time.
Same visible timestamp events are ordered by verified runtime sequence; unresolved order is explicit.
No tuned horizon, timeout, lookback, reference refresh, or incidence target may be introduced.
V2's frozen reference is measured, not changed, in Phases A-C.
All Phase C reference-age analysis includes all audited Memory lifecycles, not only V2-triggered cases.
Market clustering is described; independence is not assumed from trade count.
No Phase D/E/F work begins automatically after Phase C; human review is mandatory.
rejected_question: Will V2 eventually appear if the price is watched long enough after the original lifecycle?
research_question: Within the original lifecycle, after first Memory, when does V2 appear before the position terminates natively, under known causal coverage and observation opportunity?
